last_review.summary: The repository contracts and Prisma implementation satisfy AUTH-010-B. Credential creation and scopes use one atomic nested write; only hash and display prefix are accepted for persistence; safe listings exclude hashes and raw key material; hash lookup derives the single agent identity from the credential; and revocation conditionally transitions only active records while preserving ownership and scopes. Changes stay within allowed paths, the diff is complete, and both TypeScript build and Prisma validation passed.

notes: No tests are executed by loop V2.
Do not connect autonomous agents to the production Supabase database.
Core does not exist yet; Auth defines stable seams/contracts but does not implement Core.
Auth->Core internal request auth is Noop in V1; future signed JWT is a pluggable strategy.
